AAREYDRUGS.technical: Double bottom base attempts reversal above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with 1.49x volume, but relative strength remains weak without institutional sponsorship.

AAREYDRUGS.risk: Break below double bottom support at 104.11 invalidates the pattern; exit immediately to preserve trading capital.

AARON.technical: 20-day breakout clearing consolidation highs on 1.21x volume, supported by positive MACD momentum and higher swing lows confirming early Stage 2 structure.
AARON.fundamental: Explosive triple-digit profit expansion backed by 21.9% sales growth and 73.1% promoter ownership, though microcap liquidity requires strict sizing discipline.
AARON.risk: A close below the 134.59 base trigger breaches support; apply instant stop discipline to contain downside.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Powerful SEPA breakout on 23.57x 20-day volume clearing overhead resistance, trading comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with positive MACD.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: EBITDA margin reached a multi-year high of 16.6% on Sayakha facility ramp-up, driving an 83% net profit surge and 26.6% revenue growth.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Violation of the 441.76 breakout stop level invalidates the high-volume demand pivot; exit without exception.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Clean 20-day breakout clearing consolidation above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 72 confirms robust relative strength without extreme overbought exhaustion.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Broad-based lending expansion with AUM up 32% to ₹2.34 lakh crore, 38% PAT growth, 31% top-line increase, and blue-chip promoter backing.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A breakdown below 391.92 compromises the Stage 2 advancing trend; enforce Minervini-style risk cut promptly.

ABDL.technical: Constructive double bottom with a bullish reclaim off the rising 21-EMA and RSI 59, indicating orderly supply absorption above long-term averages.
ABDL.fundamental: Net sales climbed 15.9% YoY to ₹1,148 crore on premium spirits momentum, though operating margin of ~7.6% and moderate profit growth lag elite leaders.
ABDL.risk: Slipping below 712.35 double bottom pivot terminates base support; execute prompt loss-cutting protocol.
